article.title: Limitation.
article.content: The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963), shall, as far as may be, apply to an appeal made to the 1[Appellate Tribunal].
article.html:
60Limitation.

Section 60 · Chapter X · page 23 of the Act

The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963), shall, as far as may be, apply to an appeal made to the 1[Appellate Tribunal].

1 Subs. by 7 of 2017, s. 169, for “Cyber Appellate Tribunal” (w.e.f. 26-5-2017).
